extracted.intended_audience: Authors and researchers preparing quality improvement (QI) / patient safety manuscripts for publication; journal editors and reviewers of QI reports
extracted.subtask_description: Reporting guidelines for writing and publishing system-level quality improvement (QIPS) work in healthcare; focuses on describing interventions, methods, and the link between interventions and observed outcomes. Also covers extensions for simulation-specific reporting and guidance on embedding equity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose: report new knowledge about how to improve healthcare
rubrics_metrics.description: The Standards for Quality Improvement Reporting Excellence (SQuIRE) guidelines are the international writing guidelines for quality improvement publications. The guidelines provide a framework for reporting new knowledge about how to improve healthcare.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for publications that contribute new knowledge about improving healthcare; use SQuIRE as the reporting framework to ensure contributions are clear and comparable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: system-level quality improvement work
rubrics_metrics.description: They are intended for reports that describe system level work to improve the quality, safety, and value of healthcare.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SQuIRE when reporting interventions and projects that operate at the system level (rather than single-patient case reports), and explicitly describe the system context, aims, and intended impact on quality, safety, or value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological expectation: demonstrate association between interventions and outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Using a range of methods to establish the association between observed outcomes and intervention(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports should employ appropriate methods (qualitative, quantitative, or mixed) to make credible inferences that link the intervention(s) to observed changes; explicitly describe methods used to establish this association.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension: SQuIRE-SIM for simulation-specific elements
rubrics_metrics.description: SQuIRE-SIM provides standards for reporting simulation-specific elements in improvement research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When simulation is part of the improvement work, apply the SQuIRE-SIM extension to ensure simulation-related design, implementation, and outcomes are reported to the same standard as other QI elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity: embedding equity in quality improvement reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Embedding equity in QI — Equity in action: a scoping review and meta-framework for embedding equity in quality improvement in BMJ Quality & Safety.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider and report how equity was addressed in the QI work (design, implementation, measurement, and interpretation). Use available frameworks and evidence (e.g., the cited scoping review/meta-framework) to guide equity-focused reporting.
